name: Compeq Manufacturing Co., Ltd.
summary: Compeq Manufacturing Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells printed-circuit boards (PCBs) in Taiwan, the United States, Asia, and Europe. It provides regular multi-layered, high density interconnection, high layer count, flexible, and rigid-flex PCBs, as well as surface mount devices; and offers module assembly services. The company was founded in 1973 and is based in Taoyuan City, Taiwan.
